purpose: Predeclared complete accepted-state comparison for the immersed and FSI fixtures before assembly parallelization
comparison: Compare each physical field separately using stable integer IDs; no pressure shift, reordering, rescaling, or normalization by unrelated fields

immersed.identity: Background node IDs and controller boundary labels; converged static trial, not a restart image

fsi.identity: Background node IDs, immutable membrane global node IDs, and original source material vertex indices; accepted macro-step

notes: These selected fixtures have pressure-controlled outlets and therefore no pressure gauge multiplier. The immersed fixture additionally has one flow-rate controller; FSI has two pressure ports and no controller unknowns.
The exporter includes any actual gauge or controller unknowns. A changed set of fields is a model/protocol change and requires an explicit policy review.
Initial material coordinates must not mask a small moving-wall error; material displacement is also compared independently.
Native nonlinear, centered-FD, conservation, force, moment, strong-coupling, and commit assertions remain mandatory.
References are numerical regression states, not experimental truth or checkpoints. Collection with field output is not a timing matrix.
